file.bucket.accessLevelHintPrivate: A private bucket is read and written only through temporary URLs issued by the platform
file.bucket.accessLevelHintPublic: Files in a public bucket stay readable through the public URL; only put content that's meant to be public here
file.bucket.name: Bucket Name
file.bucket.namePattern: 3–63 lowercase letters, digits, dots or hyphens, starting and ending with a letter or digit.
file.bucket.publicBaseUrlHint: The CDN or public bucket URL; file URLs are "public URL/object name". It can be changed while in draft but not after enabling
file.bucket.publicBaseUrlInvalid: An HTTPS URL without a query string or fragment, not ending with /.
file.bucket.registerNote: Buckets are created in advance by infrastructure with versioning and default encryption enabled; here they're only registered and checked. The bucket name and access level can't be changed after registration.
file.bucket.urlNote: Only public buckets in draft can change their public URL. Check again after saving, and enable once the check passes.
file.bucketStatus.checkExpired: The last check was more than {minutes} minutes ago; check again
file.bucketStatus.checkRequired: The bucket must pass a check before it can be enabled
file.bucketStatus.referenced: Used by {count, plural, one {# write rule} other {# write rules}}; change the rules first
file.buckets.disableNotice: Once disabled, reading and writing files in this bucket return unavailable, and it can't be enabled again.
file.buckets.enableNotice: Once enabled, write rules can use it and it accepts new uploads.
file.buckets.notes.private: Read and written only through temporary URLs issued by the platform (up to 60 seconds). The check requires access without credentials to be denied; if the bucket allows anonymous reads, the check fails.
file.buckets.notes.public: A public URL (CDN or public bucket URL) must be registered. The check reads the probe object anonymously through the public URL and fails if it can't. The public URL can't be changed after enabling.
file.buckets.notes.route: Uploads declare public or private; a write rule can only point to a bucket of the same access level. If no rule of the same level is found, the upload fails instead of falling back to the other kind of bucket.
file.buckets.readOnlyNotice: A read-only bucket can still be downloaded from but doesn't accept new uploads.
file.check.failedAt: Checked at {time} · result recorded on the bucket
file.check.failedResultDraft: Check failed: {result}. The bucket stays in draft and can't be enabled.
file.check.passedAt: Checked at {time}; can be enabled within {minutes} minutes
file.check.policyExampleTitle: Example AWS S3 public-read bucket policy (configure it in the AWS console; the platform doesn't change bucket policies)
file.check.privateAccessGuidance: A private bucket must not be anonymously readable: turn on Block Public Access, remove public-read bucket policies or object ACLs, then check again.
file.check.publicReadGuidance: Common causes: the bucket still has Block Public Access on, there's no public-read bucket policy, the CDN doesn't use this bucket as its origin, or SSE-KMS encryption is used (anonymous requests can't decrypt).
file.check.stepsPrivate: Checks that the bucket exists, versioning, default encryption, writing, reading and deleting a probe object, and confirms that access without credentials is denied. You can check while the instance is still a draft.
file.check.stepsPublic: Checks that the bucket exists, versioning, default encryption, writing, reading and deleting a probe object, then reads that object anonymously through the public URL. You can check while the instance is still a draft.
file.check.title: Check Bucket · {instanceCode} / {bucketName}
file.common.codePattern: Start with an uppercase letter; use only uppercase letters, digits or underscores.
file.common.conflict: This configuration was changed by someone else. Close, refresh and try again.
file.credential.title: Replace Keys · {code}
file.credential.warning: Takes effect immediately on save: later uploads, downloads and checks all use the new credentials. Confirm the new key can read and write the bucket before disabling the old one.
file.detail.downloads.noAudit: Download records are in the audit log (object type "File"); this account doesn't have access to the audit log page.
file.detail.downloads.title: Recent Downloads
file.detail.publicUrlPending: A public file gets its public URL only after the current version passes the check.

file.detail.summary.singleReplacement: Only one replacement per file at a time
file.detail.uploads.empty: No upload records (file didn't come from an upload)
file.detail.uploads.note: Only one replacement per file at a time: until the upload finishes or the new version's check ends, new replacement requests are rejected (409).
file.detail.uploads.title: Upload Records
file.detail.versions.hint: Every content version under the same file URL; non-current versions in storage can't be downloaded once they expire
file.detail.versions.notScanned: Checking or failed; can't be downloaded
file.detail.versions.title: Version History
file.download.versionUnavailable: This version can't be downloaded (checking, failed, or failed the check before being replaced)

file.filters.incompleteRange: Select both a start and an end time.
file.filters.rangeTooLong: The time range can't exceed {days} days.
file.filters.reasonCodeInvalid: The reason code is a code starting with an uppercase letter.
file.filters.sourceSystemInvalid: The source system is a service name starting with a lowercase letter.
file.instance.codeHint: Starts with an uppercase letter and may contain digits and underscores; file records locate storage by this code, and it can't be changed after creation
file.instance.createNote: A new instance starts as a draft. Keys are stored in Vault and can't be viewed after saving, only replaced. The instance can be enabled once at least one bucket is registered and enabled.
file.instance.credentialModeHintMinio: MinIO can only use static keys
file.instance.credentialModeHintS3: An IAM role is recommended for production AWS
file.instance.credentialModeReadonly: Credential mode: {mode}; change it under Replace Keys.
file.instance.endpointHintMinio: HTTPS root URL, also used for direct browser uploads and downloads
file.instance.endpointHintS3: HTTPS root URL; leave empty to use the region's default AWS endpoint
file.instance.regionPattern: Lowercase letters, digits or hyphens, e.g. me-central-1.
file.instance.trustedCertificateHint: PEM public certificate of a self-signed or private CA; leave empty to use the system trust store
file.instanceStatus.disableNotice: Once disabled, reading and writing files on this instance return unavailable; existing records are kept.
file.instanceStatus.enableNotice: Once enabled, write rules can use this instance.
file.instanceStatus.noActiveBucket: This instance has no enabled bucket, so enabling will be rejected. Register, check and enable a bucket first.
file.instanceStatus.referenced: This instance is used by {count, plural, one {# write rule} other {# write rules}}. Move those rules to other buckets first, or disabling will be rejected.
file.policy.activateNote: Activation uses the draft's currently saved content; save any unsaved changes first.
file.policy.activationNotice.first: After activating r{draftNo}, write rules can select this policy and new uploads are checked against r{draftNo}.
file.policy.activationNotice.replace: After activating r{draftNo}, new uploads are checked against r{draftNo} and r{activeNo} is retired; uploads already started but not finished are still checked against r{activeNo}.
file.policy.allowedTypesRequired: Select at least one allowed type.
file.policy.allowedTypesUnsupported: Only types the format check recognizes can be selected.
file.policy.codePattern: Start with an uppercase letter; use only uppercase letters, digits or underscores.
file.policy.conflict: This policy was changed by someone else. Close, refresh and try again.
file.policy.createNote: A new policy starts as draft revision r1 and can be selected by write rules only after activation; the policy code can't be changed after creation.
file.policy.discardNotice: The draft was never used by an upload; discarding it can't be undone.
file.policy.draftAndRetireNote: Draft r{revisionNo} already exists; activate or discard it before creating a new revision. A policy used by write rules can't be retired.
file.policy.hasUnrecognized: ⚠ Includes types the format check can't recognize
file.policy.maxSizeRange: The maximum size must be between 1 byte and 100 MB.
file.policy.newRevisionBlocker.draft: Draft r{revisionNo} already exists; activate or discard it before creating a new revision
file.policy.newRevisionBlocker.noActive: No active revision to use as a template
file.policy.newRevisionNotice: A draft is created from active revision r{revisionNo}; it doesn't affect uploads until activated.
file.policy.noReferencingRoutes: No write rules use this policy
file.policy.referencedBy: Used by {count, plural, one {# write rule} other {# write rules}}
file.policy.retireBlocker.referenced: Used by {count, plural, one {# write rule} other {# write rules}}; can't be retired
file.policy.retireNote: A policy used by write rules can't be retired.
file.policy.retireNotice: Retires active revision r{revisionNo}; write rules can no longer select this policy. Uploads already started are still checked against the original revision.
file.policy.supportedNote: The format check recognizes: {types}. Files of other types won't pass the check. A policy has at most one active revision and one draft; uploads already started are checked against the revision in effect when they started.
file.policy.unknownTypesRemoved: {types} can't be recognized by the format check and will be removed on save
file.preview.pendingPrivate: v{pendingNo} has been uploaded and is being format-checked. Until the check passes, downloads still return v{currentNo}.
file.preview.pendingPublic: v{pendingNo} has been uploaded and is being format-checked. Before the check passes, the public URL may already return v{pendingNo} content; if it fails, it reverts to v{currentNo} automatically.
file.publicUrl.label: Public URL
file.publicUrl.note: The URL stays the same across versions; while the CDN caches, it may still return old content. Use the versioned URL when you need the change to take effect immediately.
file.records.empty: No matching files in this time range
file.records.intro: Look up files uploaded to the platform by each system, with their versions and check results. Read-only: uploads and replacements are done by business systems; downloads are audited.
file.records.loadFailed: File records are temporarily unavailable. Please try again.
file.records.sortNote: Newest first · time range up to {days} days
file.route.bucketHint: Only enabled {level, select, PUBLIC {public} other {private}} buckets can be selected
file.route.deleteNotice: After deletion, {level, select, PUBLIC {public} other {private}} uploads from {source} use the default rule of the same level (503 if there is none); uploaded files aren't affected.
file.route.fixedInfo: Source System: {source} · Access Level: {level}. Source and access level can't be changed when editing; create a new rule to use a different level.
file.route.noBucket: No enabled {level, select, PUBLIC {public} other {private}} buckets
file.route.note: Write rules only affect uploads started afterwards; uploaded files are always read from their original instance and bucket.
file.route.scanPolicyHint: Only policies with an active revision can be selected

file.routes.defaultHint: Used by sources without an exact rule

file.routes.missing.fallback: Not configured; uses the default {level, select, PUBLIC {public} other {private}} rule
file.routes.missing.source: Not configured: {level, select, PUBLIC {public} other {private}} uploads from this source will return 503
file.routes.note: Resolution order: same source and level → default * with the same level → unavailable (503). Public uploads are never written to private buckets, and vice versa. Rule changes only affect uploads started afterwards; existing files are always read from the instance and bucket on their record.
file.routes.privateColumnHint: Default when an upload doesn't declare a level
file.storage.intro: Register storage instances and buckets, and decide where new uploads are written by source system and access level; scan policies decide the allowed file types and sizes. Instance codes and bucket names can't be changed after creation. Buckets are created in advance by infrastructure; Platform only registers and checks them, and doesn't create buckets or change bucket policies. Keys are stored in Vault and can't be viewed after entry, only replaced.
file.storage.introReadOnly: Register storage instances and buckets, and decide where new uploads are written by source system and access level; scan policies decide the allowed file types and sizes. Instance codes and bucket names can't be changed after creation. Buckets are created in advance by infrastructure; Platform only registers and checks them, and doesn't create buckets or change bucket policies. Keys are stored in Vault and can't be viewed after entry, only replaced. This account has view-only access.
